title: SEIL Lab graduation celebration
description: Celebrating SEIL Lab’s graduating BSc and MSc students. The university profile congratulates five BSc and two MSc graduates, including Amelia and Hannah, who achieved First-Class Honours.

zh.title: SEIL 实验室毕业庆祝活动
zh.description: 祝贺SEIL实验室的本科和硕士毕业生。大学个人简介向五名本科毕业生和两名硕士毕业生表示祝贺，其中Amelia和Hannah获得一等荣誉学位。
